stages.name: Elementary school (K–5)
stages.blurb: Numbers, reading and writing, science and the world around us, learned with a grown-up close by.

stages.name: Middle school (6–8)
stages.blurb: Ratios to algebra, reading for evidence and argument, the sciences, and history and geography.

stages.name: High school (9–12)
stages.blurb: Algebra through statistics, the lab sciences, English and rhetoric, and U.S. and world history and government.

stages.name: College pre-law
stages.blurb: Writing, logic, philosophy, government, economics, statistics, accounting, legal history, speaking and the LSAT.

stages.name: Law school: first year
stages.blurb: Contracts, torts, civil procedure, property, criminal law, constitutional structure, legislation and regulation, and legal research and writing.

stages.name: Law school: upper level
stages.blurb: Evidence, criminal procedure, professional responsibility, business, estates, family, tax, administrative, commercial, remedies, individual rights and intellectual property, plus advocacy and practice skills.

stages.name: Bar exam preparation
stages.blurb: Integrated review for the multiple-choice, essay and performance-test parts of the bar exam, including the NextGen bar exam.
